Compact athletic build, light olive skin, a heart-shaped face, short coral-red swept pixie hair and expressive dark eyebrows. Cropped magenta track jacket over a plain cream shirt, tapered midnight-blue trousers, cream high-top sneakers and two simple violet padded wristbands. A small pair of rounded headphones rests snugly at the collar without a loose cable. Lively upright kickboxing guard; no handheld instrument, brand marks or green accents.
SIGNATURE SPECIAL MOVE: Beat Drop: Tempo pivots on the back foot, brings both palms together and pushes them toward the right to launch one compact magenta-and-violet sound ring. A short pair of concentric rings stays near the hands. Keep the face, complete body and both shoes visible without duplicated silhouettes or musical-note lettering.
Preserve the supplied reference identity, outfit and palette while upgrading its rendering to the bold battle-anime art direction above. A dramatic anime waist-up super-attack cut-in depicting Encore Fortissimo: Tempo spins into a forward kick toward the right that releases a large magenta-and-violet sound shockwave of three concentric rings. Keep the rings close to the kicking foot in sprite art. Character and attack face RIGHT, complete face and arms, intense expression and tight inked energy accents. Flat uniform chroma green background RGB(0,255,0), no gradient, no floor shadow, no green on the subject, no lettering, borders, watermark, props outside the silhouette or detached debris. All clothing, shoes, soles, skin and accessories are fully opaque in their specified non-green colors: NO green apparel, green footwear, green reflections or translucent green body parts. Chroma green belongs only outside the character. Leave ample clear green padding around the whole subject. Use a solid clean ink silhouette, without a colored outline fringe. Accessories remain attached to the character; exactly one of each visible accessory.

# Tempo: full art pack

CLOUD ONLY. This graph contains 11 paid image-generation node(s). Running those nodes consumes Comfy credits. Save nodes only process local files. No generation is triggered by creating or building these files.

All references are invented from text in this graph. No photographs or files from previous sessions are loaded.

Outputs: ComfyUI/output/hackathon/. Import with npm run import:assets -- --from <output-folder>, then npm run build. Inspect pose sheets and anchors before release. Do not put credentials in this workflow.
